mapper.insert: INSERT INTO movie ( movie_title, movie_genre, running_time, ticket_price ) VALUES ( #{movieTitle}, #{movieGenre}, #{runningTime}, #{ticketPrice} )
mapper.select: SELECT movie_id AS movieId, movie_title AS movieTitle, movie_genre AS movieGenre, running_time AS runningTime, ticket_price AS ticketPrice FROM movie WHERE movie_id = #{movieId}
